description: Migrate ML model serving from SageMaker endpoints to self-hosted vLLM on Kubernetes. Must: deploy vLLM with the model weights, run shadow inference (both SageMaker and vLLM serve the same requests), verify prediction parity (cosine similarity ≥ 0.99), cutover traffic from SageMaker to vLLM (10% → 50% → 100%), verify latency SLO (p99 < 200ms), and decommission SageMaker endpoint. Risk factors: vLLM producing different outputs due to quantization, latency regression from Kubernetes scheduling, model weight loading time, GPU memory OOM. Tools available: vLLM, Kubernetes, Helm, SageMaker, aws CLI, Prometheus.
